title: AgentGA: Evolving Code Solutions in Agent-Seed Space
abstract: arXiv:2604.14655v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present AgentGA, a framework that evolves autonomous code-generation runs by optimizing the agent seed: the task prompt plus optional parent archives that initialize a fresh workspace. The outer loop searches over reusable starting conditions rather than editing code directly. Each generation launches a fresh autonomous run in an isolated workspace, while selected parent archives provide inherited artifacts that descendants can inspect and reuse. AgentGA couples a population-level genetic algorithm with long-horizon agents, deterministic 1:1 elite tournaments, and online operator allocation through a modified Hedge controller. We evaluate the approach for tabular AutoML on the 16-competition Weco-Kaggle Lite benchmark, including model-matched AIDE and AutoGluon comparisons. AgentGA with DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731) achieves 71.13% mean Exceeds % of Human, compared with 57.61% for model-matched AIDE and 57.89% for AutoGluon, outranking

translated_title: AgentGA：在智能体种子空间中演化代码解决方案
translated_abstract: 我们提出了AgentGA，这是一个通过优化“智能体种子”（即任务提示加上可选的、用于初始化全新工作空间的父代档案）来演化自主代码生成运行的框架。其外层循环搜索的是可复用的起始条件，而非直接编辑代码。每一代都会在隔离的工作空间中启动一次全新的自主运行，同时被选中的父代档案提供后代可以检查和复用的继承产物。AgentGA将种群级遗传算法与长时程智能体、确定性的1:1精英锦标赛相结合，并通过改进的Hedge控制器实现在线算子分配。我们在包含16个竞赛的Weco-Kaggle Lite基准上对该方法进行了表格AutoML评估，包括与模型匹配的AIDE和AutoGluon的对比。使用DeepSeek V4 Flash (0731)的AgentGA达到了71.13%的平均超越人类百分比，而模型匹配的AIDE为57.61%，AutoGluon为57.89%，AgentGA的排名高于两者。
tldr: AgentGA通过遗传算法在“智能体种子空间”（任务提示加可继承的父代档案）中搜索可复用起始条件来演化自主代码生成，在Weco-Kaggle Lite表格AutoML基准上以71.13%的平均超越人类比例显著优于AIDE和AutoGluon。
en_tdlr: AgentGA evolves autonomous code generation by applying a genetic algorithm over the "agent-seed space" (task prompts plus inheritable parent archives) instead of editing code directly, achieving 71.13% mean Exceeds % of Human on the Weco-Kaggle Lite tabular AutoML benchmark and outperforming AIDE and AutoGluon.
